title: A controlling expression carrying a call the condition-call route does not isolate stays refused: 4,419 leaves on 1,603 Unknown functions, 28 sole-blocked
why: Card W43-INDEX-TRAVERSAL lowers a refused controlling expression to the typed read only when it carries no call. Measured at its AFTER census (docs/reports/w43-index-traversal/residuals.txt, conditions class call): 4,419 condition leaves in 1,603 Unknown functions, 28 of them blocked by that family alone. They are `while (i < rd_list_cnt(l))`, `if (strcmp(a, b) == 0 && *p)`, list and queue macros that call, and conditions the B-series route declines (a short-circuited call, a locally defined callee). Admitting one needs the call's own contract and its short-circuit reading, not a typed read. DISCHARGE: a card that composes the B-series isolated call with the typed read for the residual (both obligations kept), with Lean parity and a measured re-pin; or a recorded decision that the class belongs to the call routes.

title: A controlling expression whose access the declaration reader does not type stays refused: 2,616 leaves on 1,154 Unknown functions, 28 sole-blocked
why: The typed condition read admits `*B`, `B[I]`, `B->F` and `S.F` only where the reader commits to `SCALAR *B`/`SCALAR B[N]`, a scalar member of a completely read record, or a record object, plus declared pointer names and the null constant as whole operands. Measured at the AFTER census (residuals.txt, conditions class untyped): 2,616 leaves in 1,154 Unknown functions, 28 sole-blocked: a `void *` or `char **` base, a pointer-valued member tested for null (`p->next != NULL` on a record the reader refused), an unread typedef, a member of an incomplete record. The causes are the reader residuals W43-INDIRECT-UNTYPED-SINGLE-ACCESS already names. DISCHARGE: re-measure this class after a reader repair lands and attribute the moves to the reader, or admit pointer-valued member tests in a condition with the base's obligation and a measured re-pin.

title: A controlling expression with a member chain stays refused: 1,248 leaves on 632 Unknown functions, 1 sole-blocked
why: The typed condition read admits one selection per access, as the statement route does (W43-INDIRECT-CHAIN-ACCESS). `for (i = 0; i < md->topics[j].partition_cnt; i++)`, `if (a->b->c)` and `x[i].f` stay refused. Measured at the AFTER census (residuals.txt, conditions class chain): 1,248 leaves in 632 Unknown functions, 1 sole-blocked. DISCHARGE: the same card that extends the statement route to record-pointer chains (each intermediate dereference checked against field links) extends the condition read, measured together.

title: A controlling expression taking an address stays refused: 976 leaves on 594 Unknown functions, 1 sole-blocked
why: Measured at the AFTER census (residuals.txt, conditions class address): 976 leaves in 594 Unknown functions. These are overwhelmingly the list-iteration macros (`mk_list_foreach`, `cfl_list_foreach`, `TAILQ_FOREACH`), whose header compares a cursor with `&list->head` and whose increment clause reads `head->next`: a linked-list walk through record pointers, not a buffer or index walk, and outside this card's scope. DISCHARGE: a card that models an intrusive list walk (the cursor a non-owning pointer into the list's nodes, the member address a comparison operand only), with Lean parity and a measured re-pin.

title: A controlling expression that writes stays refused: 271 leaves on 166 Unknown functions, 0 sole-blocked
why: `while (*p++)`, `while (n--)`, `if ((c = *p) == ':')`: the typed read admits no increment and no assignment in a condition, because a write in a controlling expression needs an evaluation order the header node does not carry. Measured at the AFTER census (residuals.txt, conditions class write): 271 leaves in 166 Unknown functions. DISCHARGE: lower such a condition to the read followed by the write's effect on each successor edge (the stepped-access sequencing, per edge), with Lean parity and a measured re-pin.

title: A pointer step whose offset or source carries an access, call or cast stays refused: 102 leaves on 63 Unknown functions, 1 sole-blocked
why: The pointer-step recogniser admits `P ± E` with `E` a scalar value with no memory access and `P`, `Q` declared names. `p += strlen(s)`, `p = (char *) q + n`, `p += s[i]`, `end = &buf[len]` stay refused. Measured at the AFTER census (residuals.txt, steps class computed): 102 leaves in 63 Unknown functions, 1 sole-blocked. DISCHARGE: admit a cast to a single-level pointer type over a declared pointer and an offset that is a typed scalar access or a neutral call (each with its own obligation), with a measured re-pin.

title: Counter and pointer steps in functions whose names the reader does not type stay refused: 761 leaves
why: Measured at the AFTER census (residuals.txt, steps): 493 leaves in 173 Unknown functions whose declarations the reader did not read at all (so `i++` on a counter is refused: no name is typed), 166 leaves in 101 functions where the stepped name is not a declared scalar or single-level pointer (a `void *`, a `char **`, a global, a typedef the reader refused), and 102 leaves in 76 functions of other shapes. The first population is the largest lever: every counter increment and index scan in those functions waits on the declaration reader (RECORD-BODY-TOTAL-OR-REJECT, TYPEDEF-ANONYMOUS-AGGREGATE-UNREACHED). The census names readability by whether any scalar or pointer was recorded, which is a heuristic. DISCHARGE: re-measure after a reader repair and attribute the moves to the reader; admit steps of `void *` only with a recorded byte-arithmetic premise.

title: Stepping a protected formal in place keeps the formal-mutation refusal: 48 leaves on 37 Unknown functions, 1 sole-blocked
why: `while (*s) s++;` on a formal `s`: `*s` anywhere in the body protects `s`, and the formal-mutation gate refuses `s++` before the step rule is consulted (card W43-INDEX-TRAVERSAL passes the gate only for a local's step, as its brief directs). A formal's step changes no caller slot when the formal has no out-parameter or custody contract, but the gate also protects the formal-slot identity W4 and the out-slot machinery read. Measured at the AFTER census (residuals.txt, steps class formal): 48 leaves in 37 Unknown functions, 1 sole-blocked. DISCHARGE: narrow the gate so a recognised step of a formal with no out slot and no entry custody is consulted, with a test that an out-slot formal still refuses, Lean parity and a measured re-pin (the sibling of W43-INDIRECT-PROTECTED-FORMAL-INCREMENT).

title: Stores and reads through a computed pointer stay refused: 257 leaves on 159 Unknown functions, 0 sole-blocked
why: Narrowed from W43-INDIRECT-POINTER-INCREMENT (335 / 172 / 0), which card W43-INDEX-TRAVERSAL retired by modelling pointer arithmetic as an interior derivation and admitting `*p++ = c`, `c = *p++` and `B[i++] = c`. What remains, measured with W43-INDIRECT-ACCESS-GENERAL's own residual classifier over this card's AFTER census (class pointer-increment): 257 leaves (136 unrecognized-destination, 101 indirect-access, 20 increment) in 159 Unknown functions: `*(p + i) = c`, `*(p++) = f(x)` with a call, `*p++` through a pointer the reader does not type, and increments inside member chains. DISCHARGE: admit `*(P ± E)` as the typed access through the step's derived binding (the obligation on `P`), with a measured re-pin.

title: The stepped pointer's invalid_release and use_after_release arms reach no function of the pinned corpus
why: Card W43-INDEX-TRAVERSAL reports an `invalid_release` candidate for the release of a forward-stepped pointer and a `use_after_release` candidate for a typed read (a condition included) or a custody use through a stepped pointer whose base was released on a reaching path. Both are unit-tested (crates/qcore-c-gateway/tests/index_traversal.rs) and modelled (QCore.IndexTraversal), but the arbiter over the 185 pinned units added zero violation leaves: no admitted walk in the corpus releases or outlives its base. The unchanged provisional-Unsafe count records that absence, not the arms' verification. DISCHARGE: a pinned or held-out real-code fixture reaches an arm, with the leaf attributed and never presented as an upstream defect.

title: The scalar-fact join reads every declared scalar as custody-free when its binding has no target; it must consult the custody-carrying value predicate when that lands
why: Card W43-INDEX-TRAVERSAL joins a declared scalar's target-free binding with a path that has none to no binding at all, copies a declared scalar with no fact to no fact, and returns such a scalar as returning no custody. A scalar binding that carries a target (a descriptor a contracted call produced) keeps the generic arms, so the rule does not discharge a tracked descriptor today. But an `int` holding a caller-held or untracked descriptor is exactly what the concurrent card W43-DESCRIPTOR-RESOURCE-TRACKING will make a custody-carrying value, and from then on a declared scalar is not a plain index. DISCHARGE: once that card's custody-carrying value predicate lands, exclude its names from TraversalNames::scalars (or record why its names always carry a target), with a test that a descriptor copied and joined across a loop keeps its obligation, and a measured re-pin.

title: A copy of an unbound formal pointer keeps its unresolved alias, so a walk over a caller's string certifies only through a W4 summary
why: Card W43-INDEX-TRAVERSAL makes a copy of an unbound *local* pointer (an automatic array, a never-bound pointer) unbound, but keeps the unresolved-alias answer for a copy of an unbound *formal*: W4 summary derivation binds exactly the formals an analysis reports as unresolved aliases (legacy_summary::bind_unresolved_formals), and removing that signal stopped it binding them (the measured regression was may_alias_boundary::a_guard_still_discharges_two_locals_that_are_not_a_definite_alias). So `p = s; while (*p) p++;` certifies through the summary W4 derives, which seeds `s` as a live `Owned` resource: stricter than the `Borrowed` the walk needs, so callers that pass an untracked string meet an `Owned` requirement. DISCHARGE: give W4 its own binding signal (the formals a copy names), then admit a formal's copy as unbound, with a measured re-pin of both the walk and the summaries it changes.
